content.text:
All 18 rules reviewed and submitted. Summary of our position on the Kubient MSA:

**Redlined (5)**
- **LOL-CAP** (critical): Section 7 excludes indirect damages but sets no monetary cap — our direct exposure is unlimited. Added a mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' amounts and USD 1,000,000, with indemnities, confidentiality/security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement outside the cap.
- **LICENSE** (high): the platform licence is "revocable" and excludes affiliates/contractors — walk-away territory. Deleted "revocable", added affiliates and contractors, allowed successor transfer.
- **INSURANCE** (missing): no insurance covenant despite Kubient handling visitor data; inserted CGL/E&O/cyber limits in General Provisions.
- **TRANSITION** (missing): Section 4(c) covers only Confidential Information; inserted transition assistance, 30-day data return in machine-readable format and certified deletion.
- **RENEWAL** (medium): auto-renewal escapable only via the 90-day notice; added an express 30-day non-renewal window.

**Acceptable as drafted (13)** — Kubient's indemnity is broad and uncapped (INDEMN); the deal is expressly non-exclusive with no non-compete, MFN, non-solicit or minimum commitment; assignment carries affiliate/M&A carve-outs with no change-of-control exit; ownership direction is correct; no audit right or liquidated damages against us; Kubient's express warranties run for the whole Term and survive the "as is" disclaimer; Delaware law with New York courts sits at the fallback (noting the parallel AAA arbitration clause and one-year claims limitation, which we would prefer to reconcile).
